data.gender_notes: Luelle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word "luminaris", meaning "shining, light, bright, radiant". In Christian tradition, this name is often given to represent the light of faith or the brightness of God's love. The name Luelle carries the meaning “Light, bright, radiant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Luelle usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
